subject: Intro: Inference deployment at NimbusEdge — post-call MPA & next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbusedge.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@nimbusedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Inference deployment at NimbusEdge — post-call MPA & next steps

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and a proposed mutual action plan so we can align on milestones and owners. I wrote this up while it was fresh — please flag anything I mis-captured.

Summary of pain & goals
- Current stack: on-prem inference for customer-facing product; peak latency spikes during batch processing and nightly re-runs.
- Pain: unpredictable tail latency, high per-token cost from small batch sizes, and limited observability across model versions.
- Goal: reduce 95th percentile latency by 35%, cut inference unit cost by ~25% (target), and gain per-route observability for A/B rollout.

Proposed MPA (headline milestones + suggested dates)
1) Pilot scope & success criteria — data, sample QPS, eval prompts (owner: Alicia) — target week of Sep 11
2) Private deployment PoC (VPC) with small model variant for 2 weeks (owner: Jordan + Nimbus infra) — target Sep 25 start
3) Performance tuning & quantization suggestions (owner: Rishi) — engineering run Sep 27–Oct 6
4) Security review + SOC2 evidence exchange (owner: Marissa) — kickoff Oct 2
5) Commercial review & SOW draft (owner: Jordan / Nimbus procurement) — target Oct 9

Immediate asks (quick wins)
- Alicia: confirm primary internal stakeholders (infra, security, procurement) and the target QA dataset for pilot by Sep 4.
- Tim: share sample peak QPS and a short list of 5 representative prompts.
- Marissa: I'll attach a draft MPA spreadsheet and a SOW skeleton for your procurement team to review.

Attachments: [Attachment: nimbusedge-mpa-v1.xlsx (Excel) — milestone table], [Attachment: sow-draft.pdf (PDF) — commercial skeleton].

Next step: propose 45-min technical onboarding call — Thu Sep 7 or Mon Sep 11. I blocked two windows on Sep 7 at 10:00 & 15:00 PT; happy to adjust.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbusedge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tim Chen <tim.chen@nimbusedge.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@nimbusedge.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Inference deployment at NimbusEdge — post-call MPA & next steps

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary; this is very helpful. Confirming a few points and making some tweaks to the MPA timeline from our side.

Clarifications / Nimbus priorities
- Stakeholders: Priya (infra lead), myself (ML lead), Tim (product), and Procurement (Sara Lin; I copied her on procurement threads separately).
- Pilot dataset: we will use the anonymized QA feed we discussed (50k tokens/day) — I'll send S3 access to Jordan and Rishi by Sep 4.
- Success metrics: please add 95p latency <= 120ms and token cost <= $0.0025 as pilot targets.

Timeline requests
- We prefer the private VPC PoC to begin the week of Sep 18 (one week later than your note) to allow setup time on our side.
- Security review: we need an initial security questionnaire before the PoC; can Redwood share a short-form security pack this week?

Attachments referenced from our side: [Attachment: NimbusEdge-internal-owner-list.xlsx (Excel) — stakeholder contacts].

I'll take Sep 11 for the technical onboarding if that works for Redwood; Sep 7 conflicts with a customer demo.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of ML, NimbusEdge
alicia.gomez@nimbusedge.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbusedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Inference deployment at NimbusEdge — post-call MPA & next steps

Alicia — perfect, thanks for the quick alignment and the target metrics. I updated the MPA spreadsheet (attached) to reflect the revised dates and added the pilot success thresholds you requested.

Quick answers:
- Short-form security pack: attached (skeleton security-onepager.pdf) — Marissa will follow up with the SOC2 evidence list and a DocuSign/NDAs link if needed.
- PoC start: moving start to week of Sep 18 (we'll plan Sep 18–Sep 29 as a focused run).
- Technical onboarding: Sep 11, 10:00–10:45 PT works — I've sent a calendar invite to the people on this thread.

Next meeting / owners
- Sep 11 (10:00 PT): Onboarding — Jordan, Rishi, Alicia, Priya, Tim
- Sep 18 (week): Private VPC PoC start — infra owners to be confirmed by Sep 4

Attachments: [Attachment: nimbusedge-mpa-v1.xlsx (updated) (Excel)], [Attachment: security-onepager.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: sow-draft.pdf (PDF) — placeholder].

If you prefer, we can also spin up a temporary dedicated cluster during the PoC window to eliminate environment variance. That would change cost assumptions and we can note it as an optional line in the SOW.

Thanks — Jordan
